title: Meta融资近千亿：扎克伯格持股不降，无投票权新股是关键
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Meta wants to raise up to $95 billion from selling common and preferred stock to support its AI investments.
segments.zh: Meta计划通过出售普通股和优先股筹集最多950亿美元，以支持其AI**。

segments.en: Joining us now with the details, Bloomberg, Big Tech Editor, Sarah Fryer, and this all relates to what we first learned in earnings last week.
segments.zh: 彭博大型科技编辑Sarah Fryer带来详细解读，这与我们上周财报中首次获悉的内容相关。

segments.en: Yeah, so when earnings last week, Meta said that it was going to be creating a new class of shares, a non-voting class through a stock split, and that that would happen in January.
segments.zh: 是的，上周财报时Meta表示将通过权益资产拆分创建新的无投票权股份类别，并于1月实施。

segments.en: So part of this new offering is going to be just the common stock.
segments.zh: 此次新发行的一部分将是普通股。

segments.en: And part of it is that is going to be that new share class.
segments.zh: 另一部分将是新的股份类别。

segments.en: And what Meta said about that, beyond raising money for the AI boom, this is going to allow them to bring in different kinds of investors.
segments.zh: Meta表示，除了为AI热潮筹资外，这将允许他们引入不同类型的市场参与者。

segments.en: And it's also going to allow them to let some stock get sold without diluting or reducing
segments.zh: 这也将允许部分权益资产出售，而不稀释或减少

segments.en: the stake of Mark Zuckerberg, the CEO of Meta.
segments.zh: Meta首席执行官马克·扎克伯格的持股比例。

segments.en: And just to remind everyone, Google and Intel both made very rare stock offerings earlier this year that were both oversubscribed.
segments.zh: 提醒大家，谷歌和英特尔今年早些时候都进行了非常罕见的权益资产发行，且均获超额认购。

segments.en: Google's was $85 billion. So this is even bigger than Google's, and there's been a lot more skepticism around Meta's.
segments.zh: 谷歌的发行规模为850亿美元，因此Meta的规模更大，但围绕Meta的质疑声也更多。

segments.en: But it'll be very interesting to see this come out alongside the Anthropic IPO and a bunch of other financial raises.
segments.zh: 但值得关注的是，这一动向将与Anthropic的IPO及其他一系列融资活动同时出现。
